services.name: Fishing & Hunting
services.desc: Fishing is allowed year-round in the still waters of Don Pedro Lake. Tributary creeks that are east of Highway 49 and flow into the lake are closed between November and April, per California Department of Fish and Wildlife regulations. The Don Pedro Recreation Agency has been stocking Florida strain, Black Bass, in the lake on an annual basis since the early 1980s. Bass weighing up to 18.5 lbs. have been caught in the reservoir in recent years Although not as abundant, Smallmouth and Spotted bass are also among the fish to be caught at Don Pedro Lake. Land-locked Kokanee and Chinook salmon are established in the reservoir and offer great excitement on the end of your fishing line. The
